prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1283; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained significant injuries as a result of this incident and is now under our care for ongoing treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. Any statements, requests for recorded interviews, or settlement inquiries should be routed exclusively through this firm.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a declarations page and a statement of any other coverage that may apply to this loss.

Finally, we demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, dashcam or telematics records, witness statements, adjuster notes, and any recorded communications. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions.
